sloka: अयुतम् रक्षसाम् अत्र पश्चिम द्वारम् आश्रितम् ।शूल हस्ता दुराधर्षाः सर्वे खड्ग अग्र योधिनः ॥६-३-२४॥।।
transliteration: ayutam rakṣasām atra paścima dvāram āśritam ।śūla hastā durādharṣāḥ sarve khaḍga agra yodhinaḥ ॥6-3-24॥।।

translations.english: "There(in Lanka) ten thousand warriors are garrisoned at the eastern gate way holding tridents, and those who are unassailable in war stand in front with swords."
